instruction: An overhead aerial photograph captures a group of people lying on a green lawn. In a wide high-angle drone shot looking straight down, ten people lie on the grass in a circle, holding hands. Among them, the man in the white shirt and beige shorts (R3) lies at the top, looking slightly away. To his right, the man in the yellow shirt and pink shorts (R1) lies with arms outstretched and eyes closed. At the bottom, the woman in the floral romper (R4) lies smiling up, while on the left, the woman in the green tank top and white pants (R2) wears a straw hat and smiles. Six other young adults in casual summer attire lie in the same circle, holding hands with the group. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused daylight, highlighting the vibrant green grass and colorful outfits.
elements: R3 lies at the top of the hand-holding circle and looks slightly away
R1 lies in the circle with arms outstretched and eyes closed
R4 lies at the bottom of the circle smiling upward
R2 lies in the circle smiling while wearing a straw hat
R1, R2, R3, and R4 are participants in the same lying-down hand-holding circle
the group is on a green lawn in an overhead aerial view
